flows:
Navigate to https://kaneai-playground.lambdatest.io then Click Enable Notification, then choose Safari so the wizard reaches step 3.
Get the progress counter text and save as {{progress_before}}.
Click the previous-step (back) button.
Assert the progress counter now shows 2/5 and the browser selection step is shown again.
Get the counter and save as {{progress_after}}.

summary:
The previous-step control accepted the click but the guided wizard stayed on step 3 instead of moving back to step 2.
Fix the previous-step control so one click from step 3 returns to the Safari selection screen and updates the progress counter to 2/5.
